title: 米納斯里奧鐵礦
summary: 以礦山、選礦、長距礦漿管線與港口整合為案例，練習跨系統守恆。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: An integrated mine, beneficiation, long slurry pipeline and port case practises conservation across system boundaries. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 長距鐵精礦輸送的固體質量分率；管線高差與摩擦的能量分解；管線與港口不同時間尺度的庫存

steps.title: 長距鐵精礦輸送的固體質量分率：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Solids mass fraction in long-distance iron concentrate transport: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「長距鐵精礦輸送的固體質量分率」如何決定「米納斯里奧鐵礦」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Solids mass fraction in long-distance iron concentrate transport” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Minas-Rio iron ore project”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「米納斯里奧鐵礦」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「長距鐵精礦輸送的固體質量分率」。礦漿的固體質量分率決定每噸乾礦伴隨多少水；質量分率不能當成體積分率，因為礦物與水密度不同。提高固體濃度可減少輸水，但黏度與沉降風險也改變，模型只給質量守恆不給可泵性判斷。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Minas-Rio iron ore project as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses solids mass fraction in long-distance iron concentrate transport. Slurry solids mass fraction determines the water accompanying each dry tonne. It is not a volume fraction because mineral and water densities differ. Higher concentration reduces transported water but changes viscosity and settling; the model supplies a mass balance, not a pumpability assessment. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在「管線高差與摩擦的能量分解」情境，相同流量下耗電增加，可能是管線阻力變大或效率降低；同時觀察壓差、流量及電力才能辨識。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of energy decomposition of pipeline elevation and friction, higher power at the same flow may arise from added pipe resistance or lower efficiency; pressure difference, flow and electricity must be examined together. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
